scale.axes: X = mm forward of the butt face along the bore; Z = mm above (+) / below (-) the bore axis
scale.accuracy: craft-level readings, about +/-4 mm; measure stage refines by tracing

panels.3/4: middle-right, labelled FRONT RIGHT but drawn with the left-side orientation
panels.c1: receiver and selector (labelled right, drawn muzzle-right = mirrored)

parts.name: receiver
parts.construction: Stamped 1.0 mm sheet U-channel: flat vertical side walls, flat bottom, open top closed by the dust cover. Model as a solid outer form with real 1.0 mm wall reveals at the ejection port, magazine well and rear tang joint. Bottom corners R~1.5 mm with a thin ledge line at the bottom plate.
key_features: X 240-483 mm, Z -32 to +4 (side wall below the cover skirt, 36 mm)
outer width ~33-38 mm (top view reads 38, shading inflates)
about 9 domed rivets per side (~4 mm dia, 1 mm proud): rear 2, centre-low 2, mag-well 2, front trunnion 3
oval pressed mag-well dimple ~18x11 mm, 1 mm deep, centre X~397 Z~-18, both sides
magazine well opening X 372-429, ~29 mm wide, front lug recess, rear catch notch
parts.wear: edge wear on bottom edge and front/rear corners, bright rivet crowns, dense fine random scratches on the side flats

parts.name: rear_tang_block
parts.construction: Short steel block at the receiver rear into which the stock wrist seats; vertical rear face, slightly taller than the wrist.
key_features: dark steel band between stock and receiver

parts.name: lower_handguard_rear_retainer
parts.construction: Thin steel cup at the receiver front face, slightly larger than the lower handguard section, receiving its rear end.

parts.name: dust_cover
parts.construction: Stamped sheet cover: smooth semicircular crown (radius ~ half the width) with straight vertical skirts overlapping the receiver side walls ~10 mm. NO transverse ribs. Subtle lengthwise shoulder where crown meets skirt. Rear end squared with a ~45 deg x 8 mm chamfer at the top rear corner and a rectangular hole for the recoil-spring-guide button. Front edge tucks under a groove in the rear sight block's rear face.
key_features: crown Z +33, skirt edge Z ~+4, height ~29 mm
crisp 1 mm skirt edge with a shadow gap to the receiver
parts.wear: strongest edge wear on the skirt edge and rear chamfer; long lengthwise highlight/wear band along the crown

parts.name: recoil_spring_guide_button
parts.construction: Small rectangular tab ~8x6 mm with a rounded top, protruding ~3 mm through the hole at the rear of the dust cover.
key_features: at the dust cover rear end, top centre
parts.confidence: low (c1 draws it loop-like, TOP view as a squared tab)

parts.name: ejection_port_and_bolt_carrier
parts.construction: Horizontal opening in the right side wall just under the dust cover skirt, 1 mm wall reveal, dark interior; a flat steel carrier block visible in its forward two-thirds, face ~2 mm behind the wall, with a lengthwise highlight.
parts.confidence: medium (drawn on both sides, see inconsistencies)

parts.name: charging_handle
parts.construction: Short rectangular tab ~20x10 mm, ~9 mm proud of the wall, flat top, rounded outer corners, at the front end of the ejection port just behind the rear sight block; part of the carrier. The classic round knob is NOT shown; build the tab as drawn.
parts.wear: edge wear on the outer face corners

parts.name: selector_lever
parts.construction: Domed round pivot boss ~12 mm dia, 3 mm proud, at the rear; flat stamped lever plate ~3 mm thick standing ~1.5 mm off the wall, ~74 mm long, tapering ~14 mm to ~8 mm deep, with a pressed stiffening ridge along its length; front end steps up and bends outward ~25 deg into a ~12 mm finger tab with a small pin/dimple, sitting just under the port's lower edge. Posed up (safe), ~8 deg nose-up.
key_features: 3-4 small notches on the upper front edge (low confidence)
omit the stamped selector marks below the tip (no markings)
parts.wear: edges and tab bright, ridge crest worn

parts.name: rear_sight_block
parts.construction: Steel block on the front trunnion, receiver width + ~2 mm, vertical front face, rear upper part steps down to the dust cover crown with a groove that seats the cover's front edge; two low curved cam rails along its top sides for the leaf.
key_features: front recess receiving the upper handguard rear cap

parts.name: rear_sight_leaf_and_slider
parts.construction: Flat leaf hinged at the block front, lying rearward ~45 mm long x ~12 mm wide, raised centre strip with plain graduation ticks (no numerals); tall notch plate at its rear end with a square-bottomed U-notch; a slider box riding on the leaf with two spring catches on its sides.
key_features: sheet glyphs read like text: replace with plain ticks
parts.wear: slider catches and notch edges bright

parts.name: handguard_retainer_lever
parts.construction: Flat steel arm ~22 mm long on the side of the rear sight block at ~45 deg, pivot at top front (round boss), rounded lower-rear end with a hole.
key_features: LEFT view shows the arm; RIGHT view only a round boss; real pattern has it on the right

parts.name: trigger
parts.construction: Curved stamped blade ~6 mm wide, forward-concave hook, ~35 mm visible below the receiver; separate object for animation.
parts.wear: face polished bright at the finger contact

parts.name: trigger_guard
parts.construction: Steel strap ~10 mm wide x 3 mm thick: flat-bottomed loop with a large rounded rear corner (R~8 mm) and near-square front corner; rear riveted to the receiver bottom ahead of the grip; front rises into the mag-catch housing.
parts.wear: edge wear on the bottom run

parts.name: mag_catch
parts.construction: Flat paddle ~10 mm wide in front of the trigger guard, pinned at mid-height (round pin head), lower tip protruding ~5 mm below the guard as a short tab; top merges into a small housing block at the magazine's rear.

parts.name: pistol_grip
parts.construction: Wood grip: top ~54 mm fore-aft, bottom ~41 mm, ~95 mm tall below the receiver; rear edge raked ~13 deg, front edge ~22 deg; bottom slants so the front-bottom corner is the lowest point (small rounded toe/lip), rounded rear heel with slight bulge. Section rounded oblong ~30 mm wide, flatter sides, straps R 8-10 mm. Flat top against the receiver with a gap line.
parts.material: wood (grain along the raked long axis)
parts.wear: lighter, rougher worn finish on front/back straps and toe; scratches on the upper side; grime in checkering

parts.name: grip_checkering
parts.construction: Patch boundary is REAL geometry: a 0.6 mm recess with crisp 0.3 mm border bevel. Diamond field inside: crisp tiled normal map + AO/cavity baked from a modelled pyramid tile (does not touch the silhouette). Optional hero LOD0: real pyramids (~18x50 cells per side, ~3.6k tris per side).
key_features: tall quadrilateral along the grip axis, raked top edge, corners R~3 mm
starts ~25% below the top, ends ~12% above the bottom, inset ~4 mm from the front strap, ~40% of the fore-aft width (c6)
diamonds elongated along the grip axis (~60/120 deg hatch), pitch 1.2-1.5 mm
both sides; mirror c6 for the right (c1 places it rearward: inconsistency)
parts.wear: crests slightly flattened/lighter, grime in cells

parts.name: buttstock
parts.construction: Solid wood stock (no laminate). Bottom line straight from the toe (0,-108) rising ~18.6 deg to the tang (~230,-35); comb nearly level from the heel (+2) to the comb nose at X~156 (+9), concave ~7 mm step down to the wrist, wrist top rising gently into the tang. Section rounded rectangle ~38 mm wide at the butt tapering to ~34 mm at the wrist, edges R 6-8 mm, sides slightly convex.
key_features: top tang screw head at X~219 (TOP view)
right-side wrist: rearward-V inlet outline ~25x20 mm with two small screw/pin heads (RIGHT view only)
parts.material: wood (grain along the stock axis, long dark streaks)
parts.wear: rounded-edge wear on comb, heel and toe; round ding left side ~X 100; C-shaped mark right side ~X 30-40

parts.name: butt_plate
parts.construction: Steel plate covering the whole butt end, stadium outline following the stock section (~110x38 mm), face slightly convex, wraparound skirt ~8 mm deep, rim rounded ~1 mm. Two countersunk slotted screws on the centre line near top and bottom. No trap door.
key_features: c7 draws the screw slots as X: resolution cannot tell, use single slot unless the user prefers cross
parts.wear: face densely covered in bright scratches, rim edges bright

parts.name: rear_sling_swivel
parts.construction: Small steel loop ~12 mm on a short base plate screwed to the stock bottom.
key_features: X ~72 mm on the bottom line

parts.name: lower_handguard
parts.construction: Wood, U-section (rounded bottom, slightly swelling sides), hollow barrel channel visible only at the ends. Top edge straight at Z~+12; bottom a shallow convex belly. Height 42 mm rear tapering to 34 mm front; width ~45 rear, ~40 front. Two shallow finger scallops per side cut into the top edge (~25-35 mm long, ~5 mm deep) at ~10-30% and ~45-65% of the length.
parts.wear: handling wear (lighter, rougher) on the sides and belly, rounded end edges

parts.name: lower_handguard_front_ferrule
parts.construction: Steel ferrule cup at the lower handguard front, slightly proud of the wood, rolled rim; cleaning rod emerges beneath it.

parts.name: upper_handguard
parts.construction: Wood shell over the gas tube: half-round top with short vertical sides, ~30 mm wide, 27 mm tall; steel cap ring at the rear (entering the rear sight block) and steel ring at the front; small gap line to the lower handguard.
parts.material: wood (grain along the bore) + blued_steel rings

parts.name: gas_tube
parts.construction: Steel tube dia ~16 mm, axis Z~+24, exposed between the upper handguard front ring and the gas block; 3 short oval vent slots (~6x3 mm) per side near its front.
key_features: vent slot count low confidence (TOP suggests 2 rows of ~3)

parts.name: gas_block
parts.construction: Short rectangular collar receiving the gas tube front end, sweeping down at ~45 deg as a flat-sided arm ~14 mm thick to a barrel collar ~20 mm dia; round pin boss on the arm side; small lug under the barrel collar (rod guide / bayonet lug ~10x8 mm).

parts.name: barrel
parts.construction: Plain steel tube dia ~15 mm (side reads 12, top 17), essentially straight with very slight taper; bore 7.6 mm, ~30 mm deep dark bore at the muzzle.
key_features: real length ~410-415 mm incl. ~55 mm inside the trunnion

parts.name: cleaning_rod
parts.construction: Steel rod dia ~5 mm from under the lower handguard ferrule to the front sight block lug, passing through the gas block lug; flat T-head at the front seated in the FSB lug.

parts.name: front_sight_block
parts.construction: Cylindrical collar ~22 mm dia with a cross pin (round head ~4 mm) on the side, a small detent plunger at its top front retaining the brake, and a lug underneath holding the cleaning rod head.

parts.name: front_sight_ears_and_post
parts.construction: Two thin steel plates (~2.5 mm) standing on the collar's left and right edges (slightly wider than the collar), each with a vertical front edge, rear edge raked ~20 deg, flat top with rounded corners, a triangular lightening window in its lower half and a small round hole near the top. Between them a round windage drum (~8 mm disc) carrying a thin ~2 mm post slightly lower than the ears.

parts.name: muzzle_brake
parts.construction: Cylinder dia ~20-22 mm screwed on (thin seam at the FSB face). Front cut by one slanted plane ~35-40 deg from vertical removing the TOP front, lower lip longer; the cut exposes the bore as an elongated oval with a rounded worn rim; a shallow scalloped side relief inside the cut (low confidence).
key_features: TOP view: cut face reads as an oval opening from above
parts.wear: rim and slant edge bright, soot not shown

parts.name: magazine_body
parts.construction: SEPARATE mesh SM_AR01_Mag. Two stamped halves welded at front and rear spines; rectangular section ~29 mm wide with rounded spine edges; depth 57 mm at the top to ~62 mm at the floor plate. Front and rear edges concentric arcs about a centre ~580 mm forward of the butt face, ~10 mm below the bore: rear (outer) R ~210 mm, front (inner) R ~150 mm, ~46 deg span; bends forward. Front/rear spines: centre channel with two raised lengthwise lines. Pivot at the front lug for a rock-in reload.
parts.wear: spine edges and floor plate rim bright

parts.name: magazine_ribs
parts.construction: Per side: 4 raised pressed ribs parallel to the curve in the rear/middle zone, ~2.5 mm wide, ~1 mm proud, round crowns, rounded tips ~25 mm below the top and ~15 mm above the floor plate; plus a narrower rib along the front edge. Real geometry.
key_features: rib crests worn bright in every panel (strongest visual cue)

parts.name: magazine_top_plate_and_feed_lips
parts.construction: Flat smooth reinforcing plate (~45x30 mm) on each side above the ribs; feed lips folded inward at the top; plain dark follower plate inside (no cartridges unless a loaded variant is wanted).
key_features: c5 front view shows lips and follower

parts.name: magazine_lugs
parts.construction: Front locking lug: hooked tab at the top front; rear catch lug: small block at the top rear engaging the mag catch.
key_features: front lug is the reload pivot

parts.name: magazine_floor_plate
parts.construction: Separate flat plate sliding in rails at the bottom, ~1.5 mm lip proud all round, rounded front edge.
key_features: bottom of the magazine, angled with the curve

blued_steel.note: neutral dark grey satin, no blue cast; +/-10% base variation

wood.grain_direction: stock: along the stock axis; handguards: along the bore; grip: along the raked long axis; solid wood, no laminate

parkerized_option.note: only if the user prefers matte phosphate; the sheet reads blued

unseen_surfaces.surface: receiver bottom between grip and mag well and ahead of the well
unseen_surfaces.treatment: flat steel bottom plate, two trigger-guard rivets

unseen_surfaces.surface: receiver left side (if controls are right-only)
unseen_surfaces.treatment: plain wall, mirrored rivet pattern, oval dimple, no port or lever
carrier face 2 mm in, dark cavity, 1 mm wall reveal
25-30 mm deep dark cavity matched to the magazine top, front lug recess, rear catch notch
feed lips + plain dark follower, no cartridges (optional loaded variant)
same as front spine: channel with two raised lines
plain flat wood end with small chamfer, no cap
plain (V inlet only on the right)
